args.CodeContent:
"import os
import subprocess
import shutil
import re

search_dirs = [
    r"C:\Users\lorik\AndroidStudioProjects",
    r"C:\Users\lorik\anymd-app",
    r"C:\Users\lorik\n8n-app",
    r"C:\Users\lorik\.gemini\antigravity"
]
dest_dir = r"G:\My Drive\myapks"
aapt_path = r"C:\Users\lorik\AppData\Local\Android\Sdk\build-tools\34.0.0\aapt.exe"

apk_files = []
for sdir in search_dirs:
    if not os.path.exists(sdir):
        continue
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(sdir):
        for file in files:
            if file.endswith(".apk"):
                apk_files.append(os.path.join(root, file))

for apk in set(apk_files):
    # Extract package name using aapt
    try:
        output = subprocess.check_output([aapt_path, "dump", "badging", apk], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
        match = re.search(r"package: name='([^']*)'", output)
        pkg_name = match.group(1) if match else "unknown"
    except Exception as e:
        pkg_name = "unknown"
    
    # Get project folder/name from path context
    parts = apk.split(os.sep)
    project_name = "unknown"
    for part in reversed(parts):
        if part in ["anymd-app", "n8n-app", "n8n-android-local", "anymd"]:
            project_name = part
            break
    
    base_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(apk))[0]
    new_name = f"{project_name}-{base_name}-{pkg_name}.apk"
    dest_path = os.path.join(dest_dir, new_name)
    
    print(f"Copying {apk} -> {dest_path}")
    try:
        shutil.copy2(apk, dest_path)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error copying {apk}: {e}")
"
